description:
Guess a work email from name plus domain or company.
When to use: Lead enrichment when the user has a person's name and either company domain or company name.
Parameters: firstName (required); lastName, middleName (optional); domain OR company (exactly one required — not both).
CREDITS: Each successful call spends ZeroBounce account credits. Confirm with the user before calling unless they explicitly asked for validation, enrichment, or activity data.
